_comment: GENERATED. Queries a searcher might arrive with, written by a model at
build time and indexed as weak-tier text so they can add weight to a
finding without outranking its own account of itself.
Committed deliberately: this is the artefact that makes the approach
auditable. Read them. Delete a line that is wrong — nothing regenerates
it unless you pass --force, and the index rebuilds from what is here.
The generator never sees observations[].note or predictions[].reasoning.
Those are the held-out evaluation set. See scripts/expand.ts.
TRIMMED TO SEVEN PER FINDING, by generation order and not by score.
The count was chosen by measurement — swept 4..14 against every suite, with
field P@1 reaching 11/11 at 6 and 7, and 7 strictly better on silence,
held-out and delivery. WHICH seven survive was not chosen: they are the first
seven the generator produced, and the prompt asks for its kinds in order, so
the error text, the plain symptom and the situation are the ones kept.
Picking the seven that scored best would be fitting the corpus to the eval.
